snippet.title: Necromaster Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
I'm thrilled to announce my next project, Necromaster.

Raise the dead and reclaim your kingdom from the man who murdered you in this turn-based tactical RPG currently available to wishlist on Steam at https://store.steampowered.com/app/3047690/Necromaster/

Soundtrack by Bloodless Mushroom.
